correctness.rationale: Finite-dimensional piecewise-affine coefficient masks are all realized; discrete coarea reduces each mask norm to cuts. Difference commutation and orthogonal ℓ1-ℓ2 bounds give √N upper bound. Independent Rademacher selectors, fourth moment and character cancellation give (N-2)/(2√(6N)) lower bound. All 2^(N-1) masks and 2^N-2 cuts were exactly enumerated in each d=1,2,3 and sharp chamber pairs reproduced by verify.py. The all-d proof does not depend on finite sampling.
